detail.sql: SELECT 'debian_tracker' AS source, concat(t.release, ' ', t.status, CASE WHEN t.version <> '' THEN concat(' ', t.version) ELSE '' END) AS fact, t.note AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_tracker_now t WHERE t.wait_id = 'CVE-2025-14932|netcdf' UNION ALL SELECT 'upstream_link' AS source, concat(u.kind, CASE WHEN u.release_tags <> '' THEN concat(' contained in release tag ', u.release_tags) ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN u.merged_at <> '' THEN concat(' merged ', u.merged_at) ELSE '' END) AS fact, u.url AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream u WHERE u.wait_id = 'CVE-2025-14932|netcdf' UNION ALL SELECT 'upstream_branch' AS source, concat('fix on upstream release/', b.branch, CASE WHEN b.met = '1' THEN ' branch: yes' ELSE ' branch: no' END) AS fact, concat('release tags: ', b.tags) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_branch_fix b WHERE b.wait_id = 'CVE-2025-14932|netcdf' UNION ALL SELECT 'upstream_releases' AS source, concat('latest stable release ', it.stable_versions[0]) AS fact, concat('recent: ', concat_ws(', ', slice(it.stable_versions, 1, 6))) AS detail FROM rv3_up.rm_netcdf LATERAL VIEW explode(items) i AS it WHERE lower(it.name) = 'netcdf' UNION ALL SELECT 'osv' AS source, concat(o.id, ' modified ', substr(o.modified, 1, 10)) AS fact, substr(to_json(o.affected), 1, 700) AS detail FROM rv3_up.osv_cve_2025_14932 o UNION ALL SELECT 'deferral_record' AS source, concat('deferred ', w.deferred_at) AS fact, concat('condition at deferral: ', w.condition_at_deferral, ' || condition now: ', w.condition_now) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits w WHERE w.wait_id = 'CVE-2025-14932|netcdf'
